Omar Abdullah alleges BJP offered money and posts to MLAs

Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah has accused the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) of attempting to destabilize the government. He claims that National Conference (NC) MLAs were offered ₹20-30 crore and ministerial positions to switch sides. The BJP has challenged Abdullah to prove his allegations or apologize.
